$themes.name: Dark
$themes.$description: The live theme. html had class dark and color-scheme dark. Home, collection, activity, discover, drops, tools and terms were measured in this theme.

$themes.name: Light
$themes.$description: Declared on .light in the same stylesheet. Resolved on a probe. The signed-out pages did not offer a theme switch, and settings/customize bounced to the connect dialog, so light was not seen live.
